tr.pt: Na aula de chinês daquele dia, todos comem bolo e aprendem uma palavra nova: 惊喜, “surpresa”.
tr.es: En la clase de chino de ese día, todos comen pastel y aprenden una palabra nueva: 惊喜 (jīngxǐ), «sorpresa».
tr.fr: Ce jour-là, en cours de chinois, tout le monde mange du gâteau et apprend un nouveau mot : 惊喜, « surprise ».
tr.am: በዚያ ቀን የቻይንኛ ክፍለ ጊዜ ሁሉም ኬክ እየበሉ አንድ አዲስ ቃል ተማሩ፦ «惊喜»፣ ድንገተኛ ደስታ።
tr.fa: همون روز تو کلاس چینی، همه کیک می‌خورن و یه کلمه‌ی جدید یاد می‌گیرن: "سورپرایز".

tokens: (used after a noun, verb or adjective to form a nominal expression, as in 皮革的 "one made of leather" or 跑堂儿的 "a waiter (literally, one who runs back and forth in a restaurant)" or 新的 "new one")
to eat; to consume; to eat at (a cafeteria etc)
aspect particle indicating action in progress or ongoing state
to learn; to study; to imitate
a; an; one; the whole (afternoon, summer vacation etc)
nice surprise; to be pleasantly surprised

first: 九月十号是中国的教师节，同学们想给李老师一个惊喜。
